note: What must be verified before a change is called done. Targets are KINDS of machine; which of your hosts is which lives in .verify/targets.json (never committed: the repository is public). A target is verified for a commit when a gate record for that exact tree shows every listed section VALID and green. scripts/done-check.js reads this; scripts/verify.sh writes the records.

windows-11.how: verify.sh --remote-windows <Windows 11 test host> (full battery, stress included)

windows-10.how: verify.sh --remote-windows <Windows 10 host> --windows-light, or a recorded live check (done-check.js --note). Only production machines run Windows 10 here, so light only, and only when the user allows it.

scenarios.id: resize before and during a command
